text: On October 27, 2020, City Council adopted Item PH17.8, "Lawrence Heights Phases 2 and 3 - Initial Development Proposal". The Initial Development Proposal ("IDP") was provided to Council for approval in accordance with the new approval framework for Toronto Community Housing Corporation ("TCHC") revitalization projects. This approvals process framework was approved by Council in July 2019 and aims to provide the City with earlier insight into TCHC revitalization projects and ensure that they support wider city-building priorities. The IDP provided an outline of the project concept for Phases 2 and 3 of the Lawrence Heights revitalization project reflecting the Lawrence Allen Secondary Plan approved by City Council in November 2011.
